question: How many ATAC-seq peaks are significant caQTLs at 10% FDR using the Benjamini–Hochberg q-value reported by RASQUAL?

nodes.label: Confirm that the BH q-value column from RASQUAL corresponds to peak-level multiple-testing–corrected caQTL statistics
Define the significance criterion as q-value ≤ 0.10 to represent 10% FDR
Apply the 10% FDR threshold to all ATAC-seq peaks to identify significant caQTL peaks
Count the number of ATAC-seq peaks whose q-values pass the 10% FDR threshold

Load RASQUAL caQTL summary statistics table and verify that the BH_qvalue column corresponds to peak-level multiple-testing–corrected caQTL q-values (e.g. by checking RASQUAL documentation and column header/description)

Filter the ATAC-seq peak rows in the RASQUAL summary table to retain only those with BH_qvalue <= 0.10, creating a subset of significant caQTL peaks
